## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New tool or feature
- [ ] Refactor / internal improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and scoped to a single purpose.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where relevant.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Documentation was updated if behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, credentials or personal data are included.
- [ ] No retired commercial features were reintroduced (credits, plans, payment orders, paid gating).
- [ ] No unrelated infrastructure changes are included.
